author: Giorgio Mendoza
description: Sequent Microsystems has unveiled a multichemistry Watchdog HAT designed to provide battery-backed power, system monitoring, and automatic recovery for Raspberry Pi boards. The HAT targets mission-critical and unattended deployments, combining a hardware watchdog timer with an integrated UPS and battery charger. title: Sequent Microsystems Multichemistry Watchdog HAT Adds UPS Support for Raspberry Pi
